entities.name: List of equivalent PLMNs
entities.description: A stored list of PLMNs that the UE regards as equivalent for PLMN selection and cell selection/re-selection. The same list is used by 5GMM, EMM, GMM and MM except when the UE operates in dual-registration mode.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: A procedure during which the UE updates or deletes the list of equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: Registered PLMN
entities.description: The PLMN code of the registered PLMN that downloaded the list of equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: USIM removal
entities.description: Condition where the USIM is removed from the UE, triggering deletion of the stored list of equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for emergency services
entities.description: State where the UE registered for emergency services enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED, triggering deletion of the stored list of equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: Maximum 16 entries
entities.description: The maximum number of possible entries in the stored list of equivalent PLMNs is 16.

relations.description: The registration procedure updates or deletes the list of equivalent PLMNs.
The stored list consists of equivalent PLMNs downloaded by the network plus the PLMN code of the registered PLMN.
USIM removal triggers deletion of the stored list of equivalent PLMNs.
Entering 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for emergency services triggers deletion of the stored list of equivalent PLMNs.
The stored list of equivalent PLMNs is limited to a maximum of 16 entries.
